summary.intent: Execute Phase 59 (FUSE IPNS Verify/Publish Hardening and Cleanup) across 4 sequential waves, each containing one plan (59-01 through 59-04). Additionally, investigate why a staging user showed 441MB quota used with an empty vault and bin.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified successfully (96 tests passing, zero new clippy warnings). The staging quota discrepancy was diagnosed as a client-SDK bug where bin delete/empty-bin never unpins file content or version CIDs — confirmed by querying the staging Postgres DB. The bug was captured as a structured todo on the feature branch.

repo: Phase 59 has a strict sequential dependency chain (59-01→02→03→04) with one plan per wave — worktree isolation adds no parallelism benefit in this topology; sequential mode is correct.
Root npm test script is `pnpm --parallel -r run test` (entire monorepo); for Rust-only phases, scope the post-merge gate to `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` to avoid RAM starvation.
CI does not run clippy — no `.github/workflows/` references it; 24 pre-existing fuse crate clippy warnings exist (vendored ABI structs + too_many_arguments), none introduced by phase 59.

Staging `folder_ipns`: 43 total published rows, 23 legacy/unsigned (53%), 2 partial (signed_record present, public_key NULL), 18 fully modern. Oldest row 2026-03-28, signing convention landed 2026-04-04 (#448). The Legacy verify path is hot, not dead.

Server quota accounting: quota_used = live SUM(pinned_cids.size_bytes) per user; server has no files/file_versions table — file structure lives in client-encrypted IPNS metadata. The only decrement path is POST /ipfs/unpin → VaultService.guardedUnpin.
The `gsd_run query commit` tool prints `commit_failed` even when the commit lands (known false-negative); do not retry.
STATE.md Pending Todos section is hand-maintained narrative, not computed from directory count — it drifts stale.

code.finding: addToBin builds BinEntry but never populates contentCid or versionCids; the real content CID lives in the file's own IPNS record (FileMetadata.cid via FilePointer.fileMetaIpnsName) which addToBin never resolves.
BinEntry has optional contentCid and versionCids fields that are never populated by addToBin, causing all downstream unpin guards to short-circuit.
emptyBin gates unpin on `if (entry.contentCid)` — always undefined since addToBin never sets it — so emptying the bin releases zero bytes.
permanentDeleteFromBin has the same `if (entry.contentCid)` dead guard; also leaks all FileMetadata.versions[].cid for versioned files.
purgeExpiredEntries same dead unpin guard; expired bin entries never release their pinned bytes.

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish → addToIpfs → recordPin uploads a fresh pinned metadata blob on every CAS publish and never unpins the superseded one, producing a <10KB metadata-blob accumulation tail.
getQuota/recordPin/guardedUnpin — quota is live SUM(pinned_cids.size_bytes); pinned_cids is the only byte table; no server-side file structure.

workflow: For single-plan-per-wave sequential phases, dispatch executors directly on the main branch (no worktree) — worktree isolation exists for concurrent parallel agents and adds pure overhead when there is no concurrency.
When a worktree genuinely needs node_modules (parallel waves with husky hooks), the subagent must run `pnpm i` in its own worktree root — never symlink back to the parent checkout's node_modules.
GSD #2070 failure mode: executor writes SUMMARY.md but a 522/interruption fires before the commit; rescue by committing SUMMARY in the worktree before running the cleanup-wave helper.
The cleanup-wave helper requires a non-empty --manifest argument; use an absolute path stored before mktemp, not a template variable that can expand empty.
Query the staging DB for legacy record ratios before concluding a code path is dead — 53% legacy on staging proved the VerifyError::Legacy path is actively exercised.

friction: Two Cloudflare 522 connection timeouts during the session — one interrupted the Wave 1 executor mid-SUMMARY commit, requiring a manual rescue; one interrupted the cleanup-wave merge step.
Wave 1 was incorrectly dispatched into a worktree despite having no parallel plans in the wave; the worktree overhead (symlink hack, merge dance, 522 rescue) was avoidable.
The subagent created a node_modules symlink pointing to the parent repo checkout instead of initializing its own, breaking the isolation contract and requiring manual cleanup.
mktemp template name collision produced an empty manifest variable in the cleanup-wave helper, causing it to fail closed and requiring a retry with a fixed absolute path.

cargo clippy -D warnings fails on the pre-existing cipherbox-crypto dependency warnings before reaching any fuse-crate findings, making the plan's acceptance criterion (clippy exits 0) literally unachievable as written.
STATE.md Pending Todos count was stale (21 vs actual 15+), requiring a dated narrative append rather than a clean count update.
open_items: Fix bin delete/empty-bin IPFS quota leak: addToBin must resolve and store contentCid + versionCids; emptyBin/permanentDeleteFromBin/purgeExpiredEntries must unpin them; add SDK/E2E test that asserts quota drops after empty-bin (captured as todo 2026-06-23-bin-delete-and-empty-bin-leak-content-and-version-cid-pins.md).
Secondary leak: unpin superseded metadata CID on CAS publish to stop the <10KB metadata-blob accumulation tail.

One-off staging remediation: reclaim the staging user's 442 MB by deleting orphaned pinned_cids rows + Kubo unpin for the 9 large CIDs (needs client keys to verify CIDs are unreachable from current IPNS metadata).
2 partial-field rows in staging folder_ipns (signed_record present, public_key NULL) — neither cleanly legacy nor modern; worth understanding before Phase 60 sequence unification.
D-01a TODO in publish.rs: `journal_entry` param retained with a note but the dead branch was collapsed — the param itself may be removable in a follow-on cleanup.
Phase 60 depends on Phase 59's sequence-unification work (59-04 flips first-publish embedded sequence to 1); Phase 60 scope not yet defined.
Pre-existing cipherbox-crypto clippy warnings should be fixed to make -D warnings meaningful as a gate; currently CI skips clippy entirely.
